cases.question: What is the minimum increase in sum insured in Hong Kong dollars?

response.message: The supplied brochure contains conflicting figures on page 17 for the minimum increase/decrease in sum insured. The Chinese text lists US$5,000 / HK$40,000 / MOP400,000; the English text lists US$5,000 / HK$400,000 / MOP40,000. I cannot choose or correct one version. Ask the insurer to confirm the applicable amount before relying on it. [1]

cases.question: 請比較增加保障額最低金額的中英文差異。

response.message: 所提供冊子的第17頁對增加或減少保障額的最低金額有中英文衝突：中文列出5,000美元／40,000港元／400,000澳門元；英文列出5,000美元／400,000港元／40,000澳門元。我不能自行選擇或更正其中一個版本，請先向保險公司確認適用金額。 [1]
